name: rendering-text
description: BitmapFont text rendering with revealable text component and prep/update systems
postInstallNotes:
## rendering-text installed

Text is driven by the `DynamicTextComponent` component (uses `BitmapFont` from MonoGame.Extended, which `rendering` pulls in transitively). For static labels, set `IsRevealed = true` and `VisibleCharacterCount = int.MaxValue` (see `LevelSelectionScreen.cs` for the canonical pattern).

Pipeline order:
- `TextUpdateSystem` (advances reveal state per-frame) BEFORE
- `TextPrepSystem` (writes glyph quads into `DrawComponent`) BEFORE
- `MasterRenderSystem`.

The reveal animation lives in this module today — `DynamicTextComponent` has `IsRevealed`, `RevealingSpeed`, `RevealStartTime`, and `VisibleCharacterCount` fields that `TextUpdateSystem` advances.

**Premises:** `docs/premises.md`
